from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 09:16 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Scuderia Ferrari team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the nine and a half hour period which commenced at 23:30 on 30 July, twelve and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 09:00 on 31 July. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Scuderia Ferrari team during the 2021 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
title: Curfew
